interpretation_notes: A business pattern is represented by recurring semantic field groups and their rules, not by one exact JSON shape.
Field IDs are reused across services but may change renderer type; the builder should separate semantic field key from renderer type.
Datasource payloads contain both symbolic parents such as state/district and fixed IDs such as 242; this is a deployment/configuration distinction.
Cross-field expressions encode eligibility, chronology, identity consistency, address consistency and relationship constraints.
